accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:certglue-termination; thm:moving-offset-transfer; thm:compact-exhaustion-transfer

accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is a conditional field-level program: effective compatibility density implies the specified certification and transfer consequences.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article bounds deficiency distance for multinomial and normal experiments under cell probabilities bounded away from zero and uses recursive explicit Markov kernels; it does not formulate the proposal's uniform condition sup_{u∈C}||sqrt(n)(p_n(u)-p_0)-Bu||→0 for arbitrary triangular arrays.
